checks.command: pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime lint && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime test && pnpm --filter @bthwani/app-captain-runtime build
checks.proves: Captain finance presentation/routes remain source-clean, typed, tested and exportable after convergence/top-up changes.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove ledger correctness, provider outcomes or cross-Captain database isolation.

checks.proves: DSH authenticated finance facade and dispatch consumption of financial eligibility pass current backend tests.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove WLT ledger internals unless exercised through WLT tests.
checks.passCriteria: All targeted tests exit zero and touched actor/finance-proxy branches have negative coverage.
checks.failCriteria: Any target test fails or caller-controlled financial identity becomes authoritative.

checks.proves: WLT top-up, COD, payout, settlement and ledger package tests pass together on the exact financial candidate.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove app navigation or live external provider behavior.
checks.passCriteria: All targeted WLT tests exit zero with changed duplicate/concurrency/unknown-result branches covered.
checks.failCriteria: Any targeted test fails or a touched financial state branch lacks executable coverage.

checks.proves: Repository guards find no DSH/frontend financial ownership violation or broken full-stack boundary after U006 changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Static guards do not prove ledger reconciliation or provider behavior.
checks.failCriteria: Any financial ownership or full-stack boundary violation is reported.

checks.command: pnpm openapi:compose:wlt && pnpm openapi:compose:dsh && pnpm guard:api-binding && pnpm guard:contract-registry-drift
checks.proves: WLT/DSH contracts and consumer/registry bindings remain aligned for Captain finance operations.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove runtime financial state transitions.
checks.failCriteria: Contract composition, API binding or registry drift fails.

checks.command: pnpm runtime:full:smoke && pnpm runtime:wiremock:financial:smoke && pnpm runtime:wlt:provider:smoke
checks.proves: The governed integration environment and financial simulator/provider-through-WLT path are healthy for top-up/unknown-result evidence.
checks.doesNotProve: Smoke does not prove every Captain actor/idempotency scenario unless explicitly exercised in tests/evidence.
checks.passCriteria: All three runtime/provider commands exit zero on the integration candidate.
checks.failCriteria: Required service/provider simulation or WLT provider path fails.

checks.proves: Enumerates Captain finance entries, stale bridge references, top-up chain and canonical payout/commission components for dead/duplicate-path review.
checks.doesNotProve: Search does not establish runtime reachability or money correctness by itself.
checks.passCriteria: Every live finance entry is intentional and WLT-backed; required top-up entry is reachable; no unexplained stale/parallel presentation or monetary writer remains.
checks.failCriteria: A required surface is missing, contradictory live path remains, or DSH/frontend monetary truth is found.

checks.proves: Removal/refactor of stale Captain finance code leaves no broken imports or repository cleanup-policy violations.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove WLT financial correctness.
checks.passCriteria: Both guards exit zero on final U006 candidate.
checks.failCriteria: Broken import, dead/forbidden cleanup residue or cleanup-policy failure is reported.

checks.proves: WLT migration chain and runtime health support final same-candidate financial readback/reconciliation evidence.
checks.doesNotProve: Runtime health alone does not prove ledger balance/idempotency; V503 and explicit scenario evidence remain required.
checks.passCriteria: Migration and WLT smoke exit zero before financial scenario evidence is recorded.
checks.failCriteria: Migration or WLT runtime smoke fails.
